description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Kwia.
When Kwia enters, Verdant Sun's Avatar triggers, causing you to gain life.
Kwia triggers, creating a Lotus artifact token.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Verdant Sun's Avatar trigger.
Resolve the Verdant Sun's Avatar trigger, causing you to gain life.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate the Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}{W}{W}.
Repeat
